map.Sort Code 的格式是什么？: What is the Sort Code format?
map.6 位数字，常写作 XX-XX-XX，标识英国银行的分行；无算术校验位，页面按长: Six digits, often written XX-XX-XX, identifying a UK bank branch; no arithmetic check digit—the page validates by length and digit format.
map.Sort Code 和 IBAN 的关系？: What is the relationship between Sort Code and IBAN?
map.英国 IBAN 由 GB+校验位+4 位银行码+6 位 Sort Code+8: A UK IBAN consists of GB + check digits + 4-digit bank code + 6-digit Sort Code + 8-digit account number; the Sort Code is the branch identifier segment.
map.校验通过就能到账吗？: Does passing validation guarantee the transfer arrives?
map.不能保证。页面只校验格式，账户有效性须由银行确认。: No. The page only checks format; account validity must be confirmed by the bank.

map.英国 Sort Code 校验（本页代码口径，格式校验+银行前缀查表、无数学计算: UK Sort Code validation (as implemented on this page: format checks plus a bank-prefix table lookup, no math): after stripping non-digits it must be exactly 6 digits (fewer or more shows "must be 6 digits (currently N)") and is formatted as XX-XX-XX; the first 2 digits are looked up in the bank table - 01/02/07/60→NatWest, 08/11/30/90→Lloyds, 09/40→HSBC, 20/23→Barclays and so on, with "unknown/other bank" shown when there is no match. Validation: input with no digits shows "Waiting for input". Criteria: with 6 digits collected it shows "✅ Valid Sort Code format"; the bank name is inferred from the clearing prefix for reference only.
